gates.name: Repository and branch sanity
evidence: No unintended working-tree modifications existed before this run.

gates.name: Baseline firmware fingerprint
evidence: analysis/output/summary.json regenerated with file_name 'mpc2500.bin' and matching sha256.
gates.notes: Run baseline explicitly bound to user-specified target firmware analysis/mpc2500.bin.

gates.name: Manual knowledge base preload
gates.notes: Manual constraints applied: CF-first update path, USB used as media transport (not direct flash), Window-button update entry, and AM29LV641 family relevance; medium-confidence facts treated as hypotheses.

gates.name: Patch tooling smoke test
evidence: Output included firmware hash and readable boot/update target strings.
gates.notes: Late offsets in KNOWN_PATCH_TARGETS were out-of-range for this image, which is consistent with a different firmware layout and was documented.

gates.name: Static scan regeneration sanity
evidence: Command: python3 analysis/scan_firmware.py analysis/mpc2500.bin exited cleanly.

gates.name: Architecture consistency check
evidence: analysis/output/interesting_strings.tsv confirms update/flash string block at expected boot-region offsets (0x7C9C/0x7CF8/0x7D14).
gates.notes: No stronger contradictory evidence against SuperH path was observed in this run; applicability to this exact hash remains medium-confidence until direct re-import proof is regenerated.

gates.name: Update spine verification
evidence: analysis/output/ghidra_sh_update_map.md lists ENTRY_INIT (0x626), FUN_00008c44 (0x8c44), FUN_00008b8c (0x8b8c), FUN_00008ed6 (0x8ed6), FUN_00008db4 (0x8db4) with callsites.
analysis/output/ghidra_sh_findings.md documents same chain and decision points.
gates.notes: Call-chain evidence remains reproducible in current project artifacts; exact per-hash reconfirmation for mpc2500.bin should be rerun in Ghidra as follow-up hardening.

gates.name: Patch target classification
evidence: Target: ASCII UI label 'OS update' at 0xB1B28 in analysis/mpc2500.bin.
gates.notes: Classified as cosmetic/safe because only static UI text bytes were altered with no control-flow edits.

gates.name: Spec construction (single variable)
evidence: Single patch only; expected_ascii and replacement_ascii are both 9 bytes.

gates.name: Deterministic apply
evidence: Tool output: applied_patches=1 with input/output SHA-256 hashes.

gates.name: Byte-level verification
evidence: Python diff check reported contiguous delta only at 0xB1B2B..0xB1B30.
Manifest records before/after bytes at 0xB1B28 with intended ASCII replacement.
gates.notes: Only intended byte span changed; unchanged prefix bytes ('OS ') explain 6 changed values for a 9-byte field.

gates.name: Candidate registry update
evidence: Added Trial 0003 with goal, hashes, offsets, before/after bytes, and status.
gates.notes: Trial log is complete for static candidate stage.

gates.name: Media and filename discipline
evidence: No physical media preparation was executed in this environment.
No operator hardware notes captured for media filesystem/filename setup.
gates.notes: Hard stop triggered per checklist: cannot proceed to 5.2+ without documented media prep.
